name: Vermilion-Azure Censer (Đan Thanh Lô)
lore: A painter's bronze mortar that Lạc Đan Thanh had lidded and vented into a censer in 1112; the cinnabar and azurite of his father's trade are still in its grain, and the smoke comes out two colours.
build_use: The alchemist's sustain piece: burns over time, and pills that work twice.

name: Peach Spring Painting (Đào Nguyên Đồ)
lore: A hand scroll of a fisherman following peach petals up a stream into a cave. Painted around 600 by no one the chronicle names; bought by Lạc Đan Thanh at Thiên Bảo's auction in 1105 for a pill (C183).
build_use: Not a combat piece: a key to a secret realm.

name: Second Spring Needles (Hồi Xuân Châm)
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art until an authored one is ruled (review R6)
lore: Nine apricot-wood needles cut from the clinic's tree, hardened in its sap; Mẫn Tế Thế used them last in 1110, and Giả Hồi Xuân has used nothing else since.
build_use: The healer's piece: healing, regeneration and poison resistance; it takes the poison for the patient.

name: Ring of the Losing Hand (Thua Thủ Hoàn)
lore: A plain red-gold ring from Xích Kim's tailings, the first thing Kim Vạn Lý ever had made; he turns it on his finger when he places a bet he means to lose.
build_use: Luck and a little sustain: the gambler's ring.

name: Loom of Letters Seal (Văn Cơ Ấn)
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art until an authored one is ruled (review R6)
lore: A square seal of harbour stone from Tinh Hán Thành, its face cut with a grid of star-script that Vệ Văn Cơ reworks for each contract. Củng Tinh's array hall calls it stolen craft.
build_use: The formation master's seal: art damage, Earth stacks and wards that travel.

name: Golden Valley Counting Coin (Kim Cốc Toán Tiền)
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art until an authored one is ruled (review R6)
lore: The counting house's weight-coin, against which Kim Cốc Viên's clerks checked every scale. Quản Doanh Hư sold it with one copy of the canon in 1004; the Từ house has kept it since.
build_use: The banker's offence: crit damage and Metal art speed.

name: Golden Valley Ledger Seal (Kim Cốc Trướng Ấn)
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art until an authored one is ruled (review R6)
lore: The seal that closed Kim Cốc Viên's ledgers, pledged to Quản Doanh Hư with the manuals in 1002 and never redeemed. His granddaughter stamps her own collections with it.
build_use: A collector's seal: long, uncleansable Earth debuffs.

name: Green Pearl (Lục Châu)
lore: Kim Cốc Viên's great pearl, after which the garden's story is told; lost in the ashes of Kim Cốc Thành in 1003 (C174). Thiên Bảo's clerks still sift the ash for it.
build_use: Sustain and luck; the third piece of the Golden Valley Suite.

name: Sea-Crossing Anchor (Tế Hải Mao)
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art until an authored one is ruled (review R6)
lore: The bower anchor of the first deep-keeled hull of Yên Ba, which Bào Tế Hải took off her when she was broken up and refined in the yard's furnace.
build_use: A captain's anchor: Water damage, linh lực sustain, and footing.

name: Listening Bronze Mirror (Thính Kim Kính)
lore: A bronze mirror the farmers of Thê Ngô Lĩnh ploughed up; it rings when a flawed thing is held before it. Liêu Thính Kim would not sell it to the palace.
build_use: The appraiser's piece: soul resistance and one true first blow.

name: Scorched Cloud Seal (Tiêu Vân Ấn)
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art until an authored one is ruled (review R6)
lore: Trịnh Chu Sa's stall seal, pulled out of the ashes of Đào Sa in 1173 with half its face burned off; it prints a cloud that is not Nam Phố's.
build_use: A talisman seller's seal: cheap talismans, fast.

name: Gourd of Ground Vermilion (Chu Phấn Hồ)
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art until an authored one is ruled (review R6)
made_by: a pigment-grinder of Vật Hoa Thị
lore: His father's pigment gourd, still red inside; he keeps his failed pills in it, and they come out as pills.
build_use: Burn stacks and pill-fed sustain.

name: Azure Ring (Thanh Hoàn)
lore: A ring of ground azurite set in green bronze, the other colour of his father's trade.
build_use: Wood regrowth for a long fight.

name: Apricot-Wood Gourd (Hạnh Mộc Hồ)
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art until an authored one is ruled (review R6)
lore: Turned from a limb the clinic's great apricot tree dropped in the storm of 1150.
build_use: Healing and poison resistance: the healer who outlasts the poison.

name: Clinic Jade (Y Quán Ngọc)
lore: A cheap green jade every patient she has saved has touched on the way out; it has gone dark with it.
build_use: Slow cures and status resistance.

name: Robe of the Buried Vault (Mai Khố Bào)
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)
lore: Plain brown wool with a vault key sewn into every seam; no one knows which key is real.
build_use: Earth's health and buried wards.

name: Flag of the Carried Array (Huề Trận Kỳ)
lore: Củng Tinh's ecliptic pattern on cheap cloth, in his own hand; the abbey says it is stolen, and it is.
build_use: Array damage and the wards of a formation he carries.

name: Shield of the Paid Stand (Thuê Thủ Thuẫn)
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)
lore: A round shield he has stood behind at a hundred hired gates; the inside is scratched with every client's name.
build_use: Guard while he stands in his array.

name: Ring of Fair Weights (Công Xứng Hoàn)
lore: The Từ house's ring of office, a tiny balance in gold; it tilts when someone in the room is cheating.
build_use: Coin arts and crit for the banker.

name: Robe of the Counting House (Toán Phòng Bào)
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)
lore: Earth-brown, heavy and plain; the counting house sends every head to the Pivot in one so the Pivot knows whom it is lending to.
build_use: Earthen Gate's ward behind the coin.

name: Hull-Plank Armour (Thuyền Bản Giáp)
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)
lore: Ironwood plates from the first hull the Bào house launched, tarred and laced; it floats.
build_use: Heavy and slow: the captain who outlasts the storm.

name: Fog Bell of Yên Ba (Yên Ba Vụ Chung)
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)
lore: The bell from the ship-house's breakwater; ships come home to its sound in fog.
build_use: Linh lực sustain and tide stacks.

name: Coin Bought at a Tenth (Thập Nhất Tiền)
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art until an authored one is ruled (review R6)
lore: The first bad debt she ever bought, at a tenth of its face, struck into a coin when she collected it in full.
build_use: Binding Earth stacks that she collects on.

name: Surety Jade (Bảo Chứng Ngọc)
lore: A pale jade her grandfather pledged in 1003 and she bought back in 1180; she wears it so no one can pledge it again.
build_use: The stone's sustain and Metal's crit.

name: Way-Out Knot (Xuất Lộ Kết)
lore: A cord knotted the way ferrymen and carriers knot a rope they mean to undo in the dark. Sold by the dozen at the market gates; people who travel for a living buy one each year.
build_use: The escaper's second chance: each failed flight teaches the next.
